hashDefinitions.savedSourceRowFileSha256: Exact bytes of the original saved JSON input row, including its indentation and line endings.
hashDefinitions.serializedRowSha256: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify(row), with state,question,options,type in that order.
hashDefinitions.preparedStateSha256: UTF-8 bytes of the exact row.state sent to the model, including the original task-goal prefix.
hashDefinitions.requestBodySha256: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify({rows:[row],backend:"onnx",maxLength:8192}), matching the original driver and replay CLI.

metadata.requestHashLimit: The original drivers saved the complete input row. Request-body hashes are reconstructed from those rows and the verified driver serialization; HTTP wire bytes were not captured independently.
metadata.scoring: Historical matches use unchanged expected indices. Semantic matches use the public acceptableIndices sets. Only accepted responses receive correctness labels.
metadata.interpretation: Retrospective expert-curated replay with supplied local subgoals and candidates. Results cover input preparation and selection and do not measure autonomous browser completion or an independent holdout.

preparation.full: Retain complete supplied state unchanged after the original goal prefix.
preparation.targetState: Local actions retain the first three prefix lines, the first 500 subsequent body characters and the entire suffix beginning with the candidate-control marker. Facts and completions retain their full state.
preparation.localRouter: Select local_action cases only; retain the first two title/URL lines and append the explicit body/DOM omission note used by the CLI.

metadata.percentileDefinition: Sort ascending and select index min(n-1,floor(n*q)). The median at q=0.5 is the upper median for an even number of observations, not the mean of the two central values.
metadata.serverLatencyDefinition: Top-level response.elapsedMs. Row elapsedMs is exported separately.
